profile_text.body:
CGI is an IT and business consulting services firm. On its own site the company says it has grown since 1976 into one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world, and it describes a 50-year milestone marking a history of serving clients and a global culture of ownership. It is a public company traded under the ticker GIB.

The site says CGI consults with leaders on scaling AI through strategy, governance and execution, which the company frames as delivering lasting business value. It also cites work accelerating business intelligence migration planning for a large building materials manufacturer using an AI-enabled assessment.

The company's record lists no tracked AI products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers.
